title: Possible Insider Data Exfiltration
summary: Outbound traffic from a finance host increased sharply late in the day, and a service account appears to retain excessive permissions.
learning_goals: Propose evidence-driven next steps instead of assuming motive
initial_situation: The network team flags repeated high-volume outbound transfers from a finance reporting host.

injects.message: Manager asks whether an employee intentionally exported records.
Analyst notes the transfers used HTTPS to an unfamiliar destination.
A broad service account was used during the transfer window.

default_objective: Assess the most plausible explanations for the outbound transfers, identify missing evidence, and recommend containment and review actions.
